# Cesar Marcano

> Full-stack and systems developer based in Venezuela specializing in Rust, TypeScript, Node.js, and Laravel. Creator of developer tooling, CLI utilities, and open-source libraries.

Cesar Marcano (SirCesarium) builds developer tooling, reverse-engineering utilities, and performant web applications. Core competencies include TypeScript, Rust, Node.js, Laravel, Svelte, React, Astro, WebAssembly (WASM), Docker, and PostgreSQL.

## Projects

- [modcrawl](https://github.com/SirCesarium/modcrawl): CLI tool, Rust library, and web interface that crawls Minecraft mod JARs to find crash culprits and metadata.
- [re-color](https://recolor.pages.dev/): Local-first SvelteKit PWA that extracts color palettes from images and repaints them using Web Workers and WASM.
- [inventory-api](https://github.com/SirCesarium/inventory-api): Production-grade RESTful inventory API with RBAC built with Laravel and Docker.
- [stack-nav](https://github.com/SirCesarium/stack-nav): Zero-dependency state-based navigation library for React applications.
- [zipcrawl](https://github.com/SirCesarium/zipcrawl): Ergonomic CLI utility and Rust library for safely inspecting ZIP archives.
- [Type-Generator](https://github.com/SirCesarium/tyg): CLI wrapper around json_typegen to generate typed code from JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML.
- [hellcat-theme](https://github.com/SirCesarium/hellcat-theme): Dark gruvbox-inspired color theme in three variants for VS Code, GTK, and terminals.
